commit.message:
Omit redundant MOT shaders from material packages (#10704)

Analyze materialVertex() in GLSLTools to detect whether the vertex
shader modifies vertex position (worldPosition, clipSpaceTransform,
clipSpacePosition, gl_Position, or gl_PointSize). Materials whose
vertex shader does not modify position and that do not require custom
fragment depth now share the default material's depth and motion
vector programs.

For non-default surface materials, omit MOT vertex shaders (0x38, 0x3c)
when !hasCustomDepthShader, and omit the MOT fragment shader (0x38)
when !needsCustomDepthFragmentProgram, falling back to the default
material's MOT fragment shader in MaterialDefinition when linking a
custom MOT vertex shader.
